summary: The Appellate Tribunal for Electricity (hereinafter referred to as ‘the APTEL’) has - b) Aggrieved by the impugned order, the Petitioner filed a Review Petition No. 25/TT/2018 on the issue of non-condonation of the time overrun from 1.7.2016 up to the approved CODs of Circuit-2 (COD-17.1.2017) and Circuit-1(a) (COD-14.4.2017). The Commission vide order dated 30.12.2019 allowed the Review Petition and held that the tariff will be revised at the time of truing up of the tariff for the 2014-19 period to the extent of double deduction of IEDC. Being aggrieved by the impugned order, the TPTL preferred an appeal before the APTEL, being Appeal No. 356 of 2018. - c) In the meantime, during the pendency of the said appeal, the Commission vide order dated 22.3.2022 in Petition No. 35/TT/2021 had trued-up the transmission charges in respect of Circuit-2 and Circuit-1(a) along with the transmission charges of Circuit-1(b), Circuit-2(a) and Circuit-1(c). The truedup the transmission charges in respect of the aforesaid transmission assets as under: 7. As regards the IDC, in the absence of the relevant documents, in Petition No. 35/TT/2021, the Commission had considered the same IDC as allowed for Circuit-2 and Circuit-1(a) in the order dated 15.5.2018 in Petition No.108/TT/2016, read with the order dated 30.12.2019 in Petition No. 25/RP/2018. The relevant extracts of the order dated 22.3.2022 in Petition No. 35/TT/2021 are reproduced as under: > _“29. The allowable IDC has been worked out in previous petitions considering the available information submitted by the Petitioner in respect of the transmission assets separately on cash and accrual basis. In absence of the relevant documents, in the_ _instant petition too, we have considered the same IDC allowed as on COD for Assets Ckt 2, 1(a), 1(b), 2(a) and 1(c) vide order dated 15.5.2018 in Petition No.108/TT/2016 read with order dated 30.12.2019 in Petition No.25/RP/2018, order dated 22.1.2020 in Petition No.368/TT/2018 read with order dated 16.9.2021 in Petition No. 17/RP/2020 and order dated 9.8.2020 in Petition No.96/TT/2019. WAROI, as approved vide order dated 22.3.2022 in Petition No. 35/TT/2021, has been considered. The trued-up IoL allowed in respect of the transmission assets for the 2014-19 tariff period are as under: 19. The RoE as considered in the order dated 22.3.2022 in Petition No. 35/TT/2021 has been considered in the instant order. Accordingly, the RoE allowed in respect of 21. The Petitioner is entitled to claim the IWC as per the 2014 Tariff Regulations. Regulation 28 of the 2014 Tariff Regulations provides as under: 1(a), the tariff for the 2019-24 period has to be revised. The Commission, vide order dated 22.3.2022 in Petition No. 35/TT/2021, had determined the transmission charges for the 2019-24 tariff for the Combined Asset consisting of Circuit-2, Circuit-1(a), Circuit-1(b), Circuit-2(a), and Circuit-1(c). However, we have noted that the Petitioner has filed Petition No. 397/TT/2025 for truing up of the tariff for the 2019-24 period and determination of the tariff for the 2024-29 period in respect of the Combined Asset, including Circuit-2 and Circuit-1(a), and the proceedings in Petition No. 397/TT/2025 are in progress. Accordingly, we are of the view that all the assets, i.e., Circuit-2, Circuit-1(a), Circuit-1(b), Circuit-2(a), and Circuit-1(c) forming the Combined Asset should be dealt with together. Thus, we consider it appropriate that the revision of tariff for the 2014-19 tariff period in respect of Circuit-2 and Circuit-1(a) shall be carried out while dealing with the truing up of the tariff for the 2019-24 period in Petition No. 397/TT/2025. Till then, the tariff allowed vide order dated 22.3.2022 in Petition No. 35/TT/2021 for the 2019-24 tariff period shall be continued. 26. With the above, the directions contained in the APTEL judgment dated 25.3.2025 in Appeal No. 356 of 2018 stand implemented. 27. This order disposes of Petition No. 108/TT/2016 in terms of the above findings and discussions to the extent of remand.
